$comment: Network policy for the DBHub MCP container.
Two destinations, both required, nothing else:
- the Aurora READER endpoint on 3306, for the query itself
- rds.<region>.amazonaws.com on 443, because aws_iam_auth generates the
connection token through the AWS API rather than using a password
The writer endpoint is deliberately absent. If the host below is ever
changed to one without `cluster-ro-` in it, the engine-level read-only
guarantee is gone and only the GRANTs remain - so pinning egress here is a
second place that has to be wrong before that can happen by accident.
DBHub does not authenticate its own HTTP clients, which is why it is never
exposed beyond the ToolHive gateway on loopback. That is section 29's
requirement and this profile is what enforces the outbound half of it.
Fill in the reader hostname after provisioning/db/alpha.md has been run;
until then this server stays disabled in servers.yaml.
